# Midday alert, Mon 2026-11-02 (~12:25 PM ET)

**Energy group to avoid.** Oil's drop deepened from ~-4% pre-market to over -7% (Brent at a 2-week low) after Iran's president said the supreme leader granted the government "certain authorities" for peace talks; energy is the worst S&P sector, -2.8% ([Reuters/StreetInsider](https://www.streetinsider.com/Market+Check/Wall+St+rises+as+oil+falls+heading+into+US+midterm+elections/27268508.html); [AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-ai-earnings-oil-iran-048328e49e47ce7afe6c1fb9d9acf13d)).

- Moved XOM, CVX, XLE, HAL, SLB from ideas to avoid (until 11/4). Long-only desk: don't add, and consider trimming open energy swings.
- Also new: ORCL -5.5% on a $20B debt and share sale (already in avoid); MRVL -7.6% and LITE -12.9% reversed after the deal (both in avoid).
